description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzFeedAPI class within the OrangeHRM Buzz API module. It contains test cases for fetching all buzz feeds and checks for unimplemented methods like create, delete, and their validation rules.

classes.name: BuzzFeedAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the functionality of the BuzzFeedAPI, including fetching all buzz feeds and ensuring unimplemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up initial test data from fixtures before any test cases run.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of BuzzFeedAPI using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetAll' method from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'create' on BuzzFeedAPI throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'delete' method throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a 'not implemented' exception.
